content.text:
I wrote `answer.json`. Richness is 8 species, and the mean Bray–Curtis dissimilarity over all pairs of the 10 samples is 0.26895754063545735 on raw counts.

`counts.txt` had 11 taxon columns, but three species were each entered twice because of capitalisation or spacing. These were Globigerinoides ruber, Neogloboquadrina incompta and Globorotalia inflata. I lowercased the names, collapsed repeated spaces, and summed the duplicate columns. That left 8 species, all with nonzero totals. No samples were excluded.

The merge assumes that names differing only in case or spacing are the same species. The task says every taxon is a species identified to its standard binomial, so I treated that as safe. I set the status to `completed_with_assumptions` and listed this assumption in the file.
